rows.coder_note: Step 4 of the decision order: p002 gives 'the DF11 version of the Finnish biobank study, released on June 24, 2024 [21]' without the name FinnGen; the only link to FinnGen is ref 21 (Kurki 2023), whose entry carries DOI 10.1038/s41586-023-05837-8, not the DOI of the FinnGen rows (10.1038/s41586-022-05473-8), so the entry cannot carry a code although its PMID and PMC identifier match; the sentence alone names no dictionary dataset. Not rule C2 absent: 'Finnish biobank study' is a description and the outcome side has FinnGen rows. For adjudication: DF11 would be FinnGen R11 under rule A if 'Finnish biobank study' is read as FinnGen. No accession, so rule C4 does not apply.
